validity.researcher_notes: Existence confirmed (neftegaz 2023 plan, 2026 built). Classification: offtake terminating at ГРС = transmission per repo rule; flagged, not reclassified. Duplicate: P3996 (1 km, 0.23 bcm/y, 'south of GDS'), P3997 ('connecting segment', no values) and the same wiki page describe one project; P3997 looks like a sketch segment of P3996. Capacity 0.23 bcm/y unverified (possible GRS figure 10.2 k m3/h ~ 0.089 bcm/y from snippet only).
